text:
maya: quick review compact alert preview + channel suppression UI. figma: https://figma.com/file/compact-preview. main concerns: preview feels detached from channel list and suppression state is hard to parse. jordan: agree. suggestion: move a small inline preview pill to the right of the channel selector that summarizes status (e.g., '1/3 ch active · 2 suppressed'). keeps scanability. sam: +1. suppression visual: use a lowered-opacity pill with a tiny :zzz: icon and tooltip 'Suppressed until 11:30 UTC'. copy should be concise. keith: accessibility: ensure suppressed state isn't only color-based. add an explicit label text like '(suppressed)'. Keyboard: pills need tabindex and arrow nav. sample semantics: ```
``` maya: good call on visible-hidden copy. also threshold helper text still reads 'percentage of errors' which confuses folks using latency SLOs. propose: 'Metric window + comparator, e.g., requests.error_rate > 2% over 5m'. jordan: I like that. micro-ux: the preview pill should be interactive — click opens a quick modal showing sample payload and delivery timeline. modal must trap focus. aria-bot: Accessibility reminder: preview modal should have role="dialog" aria-modal="true" and set focus to the close button on open; announce with aria-live polite: 'Notification preview opened'. sam: color pass: our warning amber is ~3.0:1 on white. I'll post adjusted tokens to hit 4.5:1 for body text. keith: mobile layout: collapse pill text to counts only (e.g., '1 active · 2 sup.') and expand on tap. spacing: add 6px left margin between label and stepper on widths <= 480px. maya: copy tweak for suppression tooltip: shorten to 'Temporarily suppresses notifications for this channel.' or even 'Notifications suppressed'. which is clearer? jordan: prefer 'Notifications suppressed' as label, full text in tooltip 'Suppressed until 11:30 UTC'. keith: component note: token chips should have min-height 28px to align baseline with inputs. also add focus outline 2px solid brand-500. maya: action items: jordan to spec preview modal behavior, keith to prototype keyboard/pills and chip sizing, sam to update color tokens, i'll update figma and copy. target a11y pass + figma updates by Tue. thanks :thumbsup:
